Use JOYSTICK/D-PAD UP/2 and JOYSTICK/D-PAD DOWN/8 to choose menu items,
JOYSTICK/D-PAD CENTER/5 to select. In text screens you can continue using JOYSTICK/D-PAD CENTER/5.
In the options menu use JOYSTICK/D-PAD CENTER/5 to toggle options.

To unlock new missions you have to complete previous missions. On each mission, depending on your performance, you can unlock up to two other missions.

Accelerate: JOYSTICK/D-PAD CENTER/UP/5
If Auto Acceleration is on, the bike will accelerate until you press this button again or brake.
Nitro: 2
If there is no Nitro available 2 can also be used to accelerate the bike. If Nitro has been installed in the garage you can gain Nitro by performing airborne stunts. Pressing 2 will then activate the Nitro boost.
Brake - JOYSTICK/D-PAD DOWN/8
Lean back - JOYSTICK/D-PAD LEFT/4
Lean Forward - JOYSTICK/D-PAD RIGHT/6

Grounded stunts:
3 - Grizzly
7 - Headache
9 - Crazy Cow

Airborne stunts:
1 - Lazy Boy
3 - Cordova
7 - Tsunami
9 - Double Grab
0 - Rock Solid
# - Bar Hop
* - McMetz

Airborne Stunts are only valid if you get both wheels back on ground.

Additional stunts:
Wheelie: Balance your bike on the back wheel for about two seconds.
Stoppie: Balance your bike on the front wheel for about two seconds.
Back Flip: While airborne lean back as long as your bike turns a near full rotation.
Nose Flip: While airborne lean forward as long as your bike turns a near full rotation.
In the jukebox menu use JOYSTICK/D-PAD CENTER/5 to toggle the music.

Tuning is essential. When you are awarded a new part, try it out and become familiar with its influence. To change your setup, visit the garage. In each area you have a different garage. Also be sure to check your setup before racing.

Tires - Each set of tires is best suited to the track surface (i.e. use sand tires for sand racing surface).

Suspension - Use low damper stiffness on solid ground like concrete as the bike will tend not to jump around too much and keep the tires on the ground.
All-round - High damper stiffness.
Sport - Extremely high damper stiffness.
Freestyle - Low damper stiffness.
Expert - Extremely low damper stiffness.

Engines
Four-stroke (250cc) - Low acceleration, low speed, high handling.
Two-stroke (125cc) - Medium acceleration, low speed, medium handling.
Four-stroke (500cc) - High acceleration, high speed, low handling.
Two-stroke (250cc) - High acceleration, high speed, high handling.

Nitro - Nitro increases in power and duration from starter to Madman.

Color - Choose the color of your bike.
